front.title: An IANA Registry for Model Context Protocol Tool Surface Names

abstract.t: Two Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers can offer a tool under the same name with different argument schemas, and a client has no machine-readable signal that the two are not the same capability. This document describes a possible registry of tool surface names, the wire-level identifiers by which a client invokes a typed capability on an MCP server. It sets out the per-entry fields, a name grammar and a Specification Required registration procedure with a Designated Expert. The document is Informational. It has one prospective registrant, the author, and the MCP specification is maintained by another body. It therefore makes no request of IANA at this revision, and the registry would be requested only if the specification's maintainers or an operator other than the author wanted it.
